name: Phpmyadmin
description: phpMyAdmin is an open-source web interface for managing MySQL and MariaDB databases. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys phpMyAdmin as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Web interface for managing MySQL databases. Deploy Phpmyadmin with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
